Fixed the parameter processing order bug in `iter_params_for_processing`.

Eager options are now always processed before non-eager options, while preserving command-line invocation order within each group. This restores `--help`, `--version`, and eager callback precedence even when preceded by invalid or non-eager options.

All targeted tests pass: **151 passed**.

final_text:
Fixed the parameter processing order bug in `iter_params_for_processing`.

Eager options are now always processed before non-eager options, while preserving command-line invocation order within each group. This restores `--help`, `--version`, and eager callback precedence even when preceded by invalid or non-eager options.

All targeted tests pass: **151 passed**.
